description: Compares two voltages and outputs the lower of them and the higher of them

inputs.text: One of the two voltages being compared

outputs.text: The lower of the two input voltages at each moment, despite the maker's manual calling this one the greater
The higher of the two input voltages at each moment, despite the maker's manual calling this one the lesser

notes: A polyphonic cable carries at most four channels; the outputs take the channel count of whichever input has more.
